label: early original-phase consonant (t/d/r/c/y/k) after sequence starting n/e/f/0/z/b
explanation: Fires almost only during the original input phase (98% of mass), concentrated at positions t=2..6 (peaks at t=3-4), never at t=0 and rarely in delimiter/copy phases. Within that window it prefers the first occurrence of particular input tokens (t >> d > r > c, y, k, then digits 2/3) and is boosted when the sequence starts with n, e, f, 0, z or b; the strongest activations (e.g. d or t right after an o) occur when both conditions hold. The input token and the first token interact in a distributed way, so the predicate tops out around dev F1 0.40 / mass recall 0.51. Position alone (phase 0, t 2-6) covers 97% of mass but has precision 0.03. Does not fire on repeated tokens, on the delimiter, or on copy-phase outputs.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (input phase: t, d, r, c; copy phase: x, n, q, 1; delimiter step: ) and the first original token (most: n, e, 0, f, b, z; least: t, 2, v, i); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, t=4, L=9 & t=12.
